The preliminary term sheet shows a $20 million purchase price with a five-year leaseback. Before I can make a final authorization decision, I need to conduct my routine review with each of you. I'd like to start by hearing from valuation, covenant management, distribution operations, and tax. Who would like to begin?

transcript.text: I need to flag a covenant issue. While reviewing the facility file this week, I found that the secured loan on the distribution center requires at least 60% of sale proceeds — calculated on the confirmed sale price — to be applied toward repaying the term loan before closing. This requirement has not yet been logged in the transaction checklist. With Marcus's revised confirmed price of $18,500,000, that would mean at least $11,100,000 must go to term loan repayment before we can close.

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical on the operations side. I confirmed with the distribution team yesterday that uninterrupted use of the site actually requires a seven-year leaseback — not the five-year term currently in the term sheet. Additionally, the annual base rent needs to be set at exactly $1,200,000. The operations requirement has not yet been added to the term sheet, so the current five-year term would not meet our operational needs.
